title: SVC-PSBFENCE/1200/2 - Design/Install Security Fence at the Public Safety Building

headers:
PROPOSED PRICE
Provide an all-inclusive total project price to include all
labor, equipment, incidentals and all other incidental
cost to complete the proposed project.
All equipment must be itemized and include:
• Full manufacturer’s name and product
identification.
• Full description of the equipment – Do not list
any abbreviated terms/descriptions.
• Unit Price and extended price if more than one
(1) piece/unit included.
• Manufacturer’s warranty.
• Manufacturer’s product specifications inclusive
of installation specifications for equipment.
sample:
TECHNICAL PROPOSAL
• Provide a conceptual design that best utilizes
the existing footprint and site conditions.
• Provide literature/specifications for all
equipment proposed.
• Propose the standard labor warranty for
workmanship.
• Provide details on proposed implementation
plan.

Furnish all labor, equipment and materials to design,
furnish and install an industrial, high-security chain-link
fence, one (1) split-gate sliding system, and three (3)
pedestrian gates at the Public Safety Building.
